heureka_lab_funk: Instrumental music for a 60-second trailer of a cheerful video game about science, engineering, coding and money, played as fast WarioWare-style microgames: pucks sliding on ice, circuits lighting up, rockets, robots. Exactly 150 BPM, steady tempo, major key, curious, bright and bouncy. No vocals. A one-second sparkling hit at the very start, an energetic groove from 2 seconds, a brief quieter build around 20 to 30 seconds, a big happy chorus starting at 32 seconds, and a clean ending with one bright final hit at 60 seconds. Playful funk: slap bass, clavinet, wah guitar, synth bleeps, handclaps and a tight drum kit.
